notes.title: Version 1.1.3
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed an error when interacting with inventory with gamepad
 fixed not being able to open map sometimes when using gamepad

notes.title: Version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed not being able to proceed when Noah (The Strong) was swallowed
 fixed a minor UI bug related to gamepad

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed ineffective SP effect still triggering in prediction
 fixed a possible error when increasing item use amount
 fixed occasional UI overlapping when using gamepad
 fixed rare soft-locking when using gamepad
 fixed some missing characters for Traditional Chinese


Other

version 1.1.0 is an update for porting Noah's Dilemma to Nintendo Switch and should have no impact on the Steam version

notes.title: Version 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed Relic "Barbarian's Whistle" not working properly

notes.title: Version 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed numerous gamepad related UI problems


Improvement

 better gamepad UX

notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed numerous gamepad related UI problems
 fixed wrong buttons showing after abandoning ongoing tutorial 


Improvement

 disabled touch input to avoid unwanted influence
 performance optimization

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed possible game freezing caused by the sea event "Clash!"
 fixed Relic "Sea Turtle's Covenant" not working properly
 fixed a game stopping error that sometimes happens upon entering islands

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed the ark drifting to a wrong route problem
 fixed the possibility of game freezing caused by unsuccessful fetching of Steam Leaderboard information

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed the possibility of saving the game accidentally after gameover
 fixed the possibility of loading the game when the game is saving

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed poison counters on animals not being saved properly
 fixed animal status not being updated in some cases


Balance

 map 3 boss now always drops "Detox Potion x 3"


Improvement

 random sea encounters now have better looking UI

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed Relic "Mother's Ruby" and "Father's Spinel" applying to dead animals


Improvement

 during combat the "Restart from Saved Point" button now shows as "Restart This Combat" 
 Noah (The Strong) will always be on top of the waitlist upon entering combat
 minor UI adjustment

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Bugfix

 fixed failing to load game in "The Night Before"
 fixed Relic "Sailor's Whistle" not working properly
 fixed total SP prediction including next day SP growth
 fixed total SP prediction turning into a wrong color in some cases
 fixed game freezing when enemies and animals died together in some cases


Balance

 Lv4 room buff 200 SP -> 150 SP


Improvement

 animals in waitlist are now ordered by Attack from high to low upon entering combat
